ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-24-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of THREE Minors.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Denise Doucette.
Petitioner: William Vuthy Wong fka William Phang and Sophia Phy Wong fka Sophia Phy Phang, present as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Jennifer Phang, Jonathan Voroman Phang and Joanna Phang.
Petitioners were sworn adn examind.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minors to: Jennifer Wong, Jonathan Voroman Wong and Joanna Wong.
Decree signed in open court.
